lead.headline: Likely starts on a Friday DNP, and covering him would still cost Jacobs
lead.deck: Nothing new overnight. The call holds until 13:55 inactives. Daniels and Tuten are cleared; Taylor's 6.7 is final.
lead.body: Bad news first: Isaiah Likely did not practise Friday (groin), and nothing newer had appeared by 07:00 Sunday. The Giants gave him no status and Harbaugh called it 'a minor thing', so he starts, provisionally until 13:55 CDMX inactives. You carry no second tight end. By 13:55 the only unlocked seats are Jacobs' and Golden's. The call is still to take the zero rather than cut Jacobs before his likely Week 12 return. Daniels practised fully all week. The lineup as set is the projection lineup.
